hub.title: Book local services in Ottawa | Luminexa
hub.description: Luminexa helps Ottawa residents book snow removal, car detailing, home cleaning, and other local jobs — with prices and real time slots.
hub.intro: Luminexa is a booking app for everyday jobs in Ottawa, including snow removal and car detailing. Find providers who serve your neighbourhood, see prices or request a quote, and lock in a time without phone tag.

faq.a: Luminexa is a local service booking platform. Customers in Ottawa find nearby providers and book open time slots. Businesses publish services, a service area, and a calendar.
Yes. Ottawa is one of Luminexa’s launch cities in Ontario, Canada. You search by address or postal code. A provider appears only if you are inside both your search radius and their service area.

faq.q: Can I book snow removal, car detailing, or gardening in Ottawa?
faq.a: Yes — those are jobs we highlight. Snow and garden crews often list under Yard & outdoors; detailers often list under Auto & vehicles. Availability depends on which Ottawa providers are on Luminexa.

faq.q: How do I book a service?
faq.a: Open Luminexa, enter your Ottawa address or postal code, choose a category, compare providers, and pick an open slot or send a request. You can also install the Luminexa app from Google Play.
Yes. Toronto is a launch city alongside Ottawa. The product works by distance and service area, so you see providers who actually cover your address.
